24k Autoclavable Remote Control

The C8115 is a fully autoclavable remote for the 24k Pump. The C8115 is a 6 button, 9 function remote that allows control of pressure, flow rates, suction rates, tamponade function, Clearfield function, shaver declog function, drain function and run and stop.

24k Interface Cable
The 24K Interface Cable provides a direct connection between the D4000/D4000A console and the 24K pump, allowing the 24K pump to control suction through the shaver handpiece.
24K Interface Cable
24k Shaver Sensor
The 24k900 Shaver Sensor connects to the 24k Pump and clips to the cable of any shaver handpiece allowing the 24k Pump to control suction through the shaver handpiece.

® Arthroscopic Tubing — 24kTIPS Tube Set
